source: Frozen from libphonenumber (phonenumbers 9.0.43) so the tests give the same answer with any phonenumbers version or none. lengths: per dial code, the lengths a national number may have when it starts with 0 and otherwise, across every region with that country calling code: all fixed-line and mobile lengths, plus other number types' lengths unless a region uses that length for local numbers dialled without the area code; starting with 0 only where the trunk prefix is not 0. national_numbers: every number type's example number. written: the fixed-line and mobile examples as E.164, international, national and bare text. left_out: examples the fallback rejects on purpose, with the reason.

left_out.reason: another number type, with a length the region also uses for local numbers
